One avenue for growth is providing services to other banks, a business Citi was previously constrained from aggressively pursuing while it owned Banamex, he said. "Citi globally tends to be a bank for banks," Brossier said, citing the lender's international footprint and financial infrastructure. The shift is already yielding results, Brossier added, with Banamex itself set to become an important client. Citi [USN:L1N46011S TEXT:"recently led Banamex's additional tier-one bond issuance"], the retail bank's first sale of high-risk debt as it builds an independent balance sheet following its separation from Citi. Citi is also set to play a role in Banamex's eventual IPO. Brossier also pointed to business with BBVA (BBVA.MC) in Mexico, saying Citi has handled bond issuances for the bank -- work he said would have been unlikely when Banamex was still part of Citi. Citi also sees opportunities to expand its commercial banking segment, which serves mid-sized companies, as well as private banking. He said the strategy mirrors Citi's approach in Brazil, where commercial banking brings fast-growing companies into the franchise with the aim of developing them into larger institutional clients. "That is a client-acquisition business," Brossier said of commercial banking in Mexico. "For the rest of the franchise, the focus is on deepening relationships with the clients we already have."

item.title: North Dakota oil companies speed up well completions as prices rise, state regulator says
item.description: US oil and gas companies are accelerating well completions and boosting production in North Dakota, the nation's third-largest oil-producing state, encouraged by high crude prices, state officials said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Siddharth Cavale
item.content:encoded: US oil and gas companies are accelerating well completions and boosting production in North Dakota, the nation's third-largest oil-producing state, encouraged by high crude prices, state officials said on Tuesday. "Operators are acting more quickly to move wells to production to capitalize on elevated oil prices," Richard Suggs, a geologist with North Dakota's Oil and Gas Division, said during a call to discuss the state's August production data, the latest available. US West Texas Intermediate [USN:L1N46201B TEXT:"futures topped "]$100 a barrel for the first time in nearly a month last week amid concerns that the Iran war could further tighten supplies. On Tuesday, WTI, the benchmark against which North Dakota crude is priced, was trading at around $102 a barrel. North Dakota crude traded at an average discount of about $4.21 a barrel to WTI through August, officials said. The time between drilling and preparing a well for production has roughly halved since the start of the year, Suggs said. Wells are also coming online more quickly than normal, he added. RECORD NUMBER OF PRODUCING WELLS The faster pace helped push the state's total producing wells to a record high of 20,177 in August, Suggs said. There are 36 drilling rigs operating in North Dakota, up from 34 in September, with eight hydraulic fracturing crews active, according to state data. Oil production rose by 3,000 barrels per day to 1.161 million bpd in August. However, the price gap between refiners on the US West Coast and East Coast has widened, according to the latest data collected, said Justin Kringstad, director of the North Dakota Pipeline Authority. West Coast refiners paid about $93.51 per barrel for North Dakota crude, compared with $88.27 per barrel on the East Coast in July. "This is the biggest spread I have seen in a little while," Kringstad said, adding the differential is typically 50 cents to $1 a barrel. Kringstad said East Coast prices are particularly sensitive to crude supplies arriving via waterborne imports, the US Gulf Coast and rail, and that disruptions to those flows may have contributed to the price gap. Kringstad said refinery demand remains strong. Refinery utilization rates have eased, particularly in the Midwest, as plants enter the September-through-November maintenance season, but remain above 80%, he said.

item.title: Late NASCAR driver Fred Lorenzen linked to CTE
item.description: Former Daytona 500 winner Fred Lorenzen, who died in 2024 at the age of 89, has been posthumously diagnosed with CTE.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Former Daytona 500 winner Fred Lorenzen, who died in 2024 at the age of 89, has been posthumously diagnosed with CTE. The Boston University CTE Center diagnosed him with Stage 3 chronic traumatic encephalopathy, making him the first known NASCAR driver linked to the brain disease associated with repeated head impacts. Lorenzen's family shared the results of the recent postmortem brain analysis with USA Today for an article published on Tuesday. His children, Chris Lorenzen and Amanda Lorenzen-Gardstrom, said their father spent his final years living in a nursing home and showing signs of dementia. "It's overwhelming to get to where we are today," Lorenzen-Gardstrom said. "There were so many stages of grief, of loss and not understanding things. It makes me understand why. It doesn't make anything better at all, but it makes me able to understand why things happened the way they happened." CTE has been more closely connected to head injuries suffered by football players or participants in other contact sports, but Lorenzen's son was not surprised by the diagnosis. "In my head, it was like, we already know that," Chris Lorenzen said. "Just in my opinion, if we're seeing all these former NFL players with CTE from head injuries, how would NASCAR be any different? This is going high speeds, into a wall, into another car. It's the same thing. "I think we know what the results of other drivers donating their brain is going to be. So, the question is, can we somehow help these injured drivers earlier? Because our dad didn't have any help." NASCAR did not respond to USA Today's request for a comment. Lorenzen won 26 races between 1956 and 1967, including the 1965 Daytona 500. --Field Level Media

item.title: Tubarão mata mulher na costa do Cabo Oriental, na África do Sul
item.description: Uma mulher de 65 anos foi morta por um tubarão nesta terça-feira em uma praia popular na costa da província do Cabo Oriental, na África do Sul, informaram autoridades locais.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Uma mulher de 65 anos foi morta por um tubarão nesta terça-feira em uma praia popular na costa da província do Cabo Oriental, na África do Sul, informaram autoridades locais. “Um ataque fatal de tubarão ocorreu na Praia de Orient nesta manhã, resultando na trágica perda de uma banhista”, disse um porta-voz da prefeitura local à Reuters. A mulher estava nadando com um grupo quando sinalizou que estava em apuros, contou uma testemunha à emissora pública SABC. “Todos percebemos que ela havia sido mordida por um tubarão e que estava em péssimo estado”, disse a testemunha. “As mordidas foram muito graves, mas foram apenas duas: uma na coxa e outra no braço.” Ele disse que a mulher foi levada de volta à costa, onde foi declarada morta na praia. Moradores se reuniram perto do corpo coberto da mulher, que estava deitado sobre uma prancha de surfe perto da Praia Orient, na cidade de KuGompo. A polícia do Cabo Oriental informou que os policiais que compareceram ao local e abriram um inquérito. A espécie do tubarão envolvido não foi identificada de imediato. A prefeitura de Buffalo City fechou a praia e a vizinha Eastern Beach até segunda ordem e pediu que as pessoas tomem cuidado. A costa da África do Sul abriga muitas espécies de tubarões, mas é popularmente conhecida pelos grandes tubarões brancos, que atraem turistas de todo o mundo para mergulhos em gaiolas e passeios de observação de tubarões.

item.title: Irán le dice a enviado paquistaní que no habrá conversación con EEUU si no se cumplen exigencias
item.description: Irán comunicó el martes al jefe del ejército paquistaní que no habría conversaciones con Washington hasta que se cumplan las exigencias de Teherán, informó la prensa local, lo que subraya su postura cada vez más intransigente, a pesar de los esfuerzos de mediación de su principal interlocutor, Pakistán.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Irán comunicó el martes al jefe del ejército paquistaní que no habría conversaciones con Washington hasta que se cumplan las exigencias de Teherán, informó la prensa local, lo que subraya su postura cada vez más intransigente, a pesar de los esfuerzos de mediación de su principal interlocutor, Pakistán. Según Nournews, el presidente iraní Masoud Pezeshkian conversó con el mariscal de campo Asim Munir en Teherán sobre los esfuerzos de mediación y los acontecimientos regionales. Los esfuerzos de mediación previos de Pakistán contribuyeron a lograr un acuerdo de paz provisional en junio, pero el Memorando de Islamabad se desmoronó rápidamente cuando los combates entre Irán y Estados Unidos se reanudaron semanas después. Munir también se reunió con el presidente del Parlamento iraní, Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, quien dijo que Washington no podría recuperar la confianza de Teherán hasta que cumpla las siete condiciones que Irán estableció el mes pasado para la reapertura del estrecho de Ormuz, según un comunicado iraní sobre la reunión. Entre las demandas se incluyen el fin del bloqueo estadounidense a sus puertos, el levantamiento de las sanciones a sus exportaciones de petróleo, así como el cese de las hostilidades en todos los frentes regionales. El vicepresidente de Estados Unidos, JD Vance, dijo a principios de este mes que Irán debe reducir "significativamente" su capacidad de enriquecimiento de uranio para satisfacer las demandas estadounidenses y poner fin a la guerra que libran ambos países desde hace ocho meses.

item.title: Bank of England's Greene says inflation risks are bigger than thought
item.description: Bank of England policymaker Megan Greene said the risks of a pickup in broader inflation as a result of the energy price shock from the Iran war were greater than the BoE expected and she reiterated her view that interest rates should go up.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bank of England policymaker Megan Greene said the risks of a pickup in broader inflation as a result of the energy price shock from the Iran war were greater than the BoE expected and she reiterated her view that interest rates should go up. Greene – part of a minority on the BoE's Monetary Policy Committee that has voted for higher rates – said it was better to act as if the so-called second-round effects from the energy shock were stronger and then adjust policy later if needed. "I therefore continue to believe we should proactively lean against the risk of second-round effects," she said in a speech at the London School of Economics on Tuesday. So far the BoE has not followed the US Federal Reserve and the European Central Bank in increasing borrowing costs in response to the Iran war. But Governor Andrew Bailey, who has backed keeping rates on hold, has [USN:L1N46202H TEXT:"said"] that the longer the conflict goes on, the harder it will be for the BoE not to respond, although he thought inflation pressures remained "quite subdued". Investors expect the BoE will raise its benchmark Bank Rate by a quarter of a percentage point to 4% next month. In her speech, Greene said she believed wage growth was running higher than official data has suggested and pay settlements due in early 2027 might come in higher than thought given inflation was likely to be running around 4% then. She said signs of resilience in Britain's economy this year, despite the energy price jump, added to the case for higher borrowing costs. "It is not obvious to me from this data that our monetary policy stance is meaningfully restrictive," Greene said.

item.title: WWE, McMahons must face sex abuse claims by former 'ring boys'
item.description: A federal judge has denied a bid by World Wrestling Entertainment and former executives Vince and Linda McMahon to dismiss a lawsuit claiming they are liable for years of alleged sexual abuse suffered by teenage "ring boys" in the 1980s and 1990s.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Wiessner
item.content:encoded: A federal judge has denied a bid by World Wrestling Entertainment and former executives Vince and Linda McMahon to dismiss a lawsuit claiming they are liable for years of alleged sexual abuse suffered by teenage "ring boys" in the 1980s and 1990s. US District Judge James Bredar in Baltimore on Monday rejected claims that a 2023 Maryland law allowing the plaintiffs to sue over decades-old allegations violated the US Constitution and the defendants' right to due process. The eight anonymous plaintiffs say in the 2024 lawsuit that they were recruited by ringside announcer Melvin Phillips to work as part-time crew members and were abused by him and two other officials at WWE, then known as WWF. Phillips and the other alleged abusers died years before the plaintiffs filed the lawsuit. WWE and lawyers for Vince McMahon and Linda McMahon, the current US Secretary of Education, and the plaintiffs did not immediately respond to requests for comment on Tuesday. The Maryland law eliminated a seven-year statute of limitations for sex abuse claims involving minors, which had been extended from three years in 2003. It was part of a wave of state laws adopted after the #MeToo movement allowing sex abuse claims previously blocked by statutes of limitations to proceed, in some cases temporarily. The plaintiffs in their lawsuit accused WWE and the McMahons of negligence and negligent hiring and retention, and are seeking unspecified damages. Vince McMahon, who built WWF into a cultural force in the 1980s after purchasing its predecessor from his father, [USN:L1N3EH03B TEXT:"resigned from the organization"] in 2024 amid separate claims of sex trafficking and assault, which [USN:FWN3O60QP TEXT:"he has denied"]. Linda McMahon, his estranged wife, was [USN:L1N3P316M TEXT:"appointed US Secretary of Education"] by President Donald Trump last year after heading the US Small Business Administration during Trump's first term. She and Vince McMahon have previously denied having knowledge of alleged abuse of ring boys. The defendants argued that Maryland's law violated the US Constitution's ban on retroactive, or ex post facto, laws, and that it violated the Constitution's guarantee of due process as applied to them. They said it could be difficult or impossible to mount a defense as witnesses become unavailable, memories fade and other evidence is lost. But Bredar on Monday said the law served a legitimate purpose of addressing the barriers that child sex abuse victims face in court, and that the concerns raised by WWE were overblown. "Plaintiffs can make a case by producing at least some material facts to contest, documents to dispute, and witnesses to cross-examine," the judge wrote. The Maryland Supreme Court last year rejected arguments that the law violated the state's constitution, which Bredar on Monday said had raised distinct issues from the former ring boys' case. But the top courts in several other states including Maine, Utah and Kentucky have said in recent years that similar laws were invalid because expired statutes of limitations are not reversible. The case is Doe v. World Wrestling Entertainment, US District Court for the District of Maryland, No. 1:24-cv-03487. item.title: World Series Game 1 tickets surge above $3K, nearing Super Bowl level
item.description: The price to get into Game 1 of the World Series when the Tampa Bay Rays visit the Milwaukee Brewers on Friday night has soared to near Super Bowl prices.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The price to get into Game 1 of the World Series when the Tampa Bay Rays visit the Milwaukee Brewers on Friday night has soared to near Super Bowl prices. The get-in price for Game 1 at American Family Field reached $3,107 by midday Tuesday, according to TicketData.com. That slightly was down from a spike to $3,169 on Monday night after the Rays clinched the American League Championship Series against the Cleveland Guardians, but still represented a 14% increase over the past three days. By comparison, the get-in price for tickets to Super Bowl LX in February settled at $3,361 hours before the game won by the Seattle Seahawks over the New England Patriots in Santa Clara, Calif. "If the price for Game 1 holds, that would set a record for the most expensive World Series game ever," TicketData.com's Keith Pagello told Field Level Media. According to the service, the highest get-in price to a World Series game in history was for Game 4 between Cleveland and the Chicago Cubs at Wrigley Field in 2016. The get-in price 90 minutes before first pitch for that game a decade ago was $1,809. That topped the $1,609 get-in price for Game 3 the previous day. Third on the list was the $1,584 get-in price for Game 3 between Houston at Washington in 2019. The most expensive World Series get-in price since then was $1,377 for Game 7 between the Los Angeles Dodgers and Blue Jays in Toronto last year. Game 2 of the 2026 World Series will also be in Milwaukee, with the get-in price up 7% over the past three days to $2,748. The get-in price for Games 3-5 in St. Petersburg, Fla., are the three lowest among the potential seven games. 2026 WORLD SERIES GET-IN PRICES* Game 1, Oct. 23 in Milwaukee: $3,107 Game 2, Oct. 24 in Milwaukee: $2,748 Game 3, Oct. 26 in St. Petersburg: $766 Game 4, Oct. 27 in St. Petersburg: $823 Game 5, Oct. 28 in St. Petersburg: $791 Game 6, Oct. 30 in Milwaukee: $2,133 Game 7, Oct. 31 in Milwaukee: $2,529 *TicketData.com Milwaukee and Tampa Bay are each seeking the first World Series title in franchise history. This will be the Rays' third appearance in the World Series after they won three consecutive games to eliminate the Guardians on Monday. Tampa Bay fell in five games to the Philadelphia Phillies in 2008 and in six games to the Dodgers in 2020. The Brewers swept the Dodgers in the National League Championship Series to reach their first World Series in 44 years. Milwaukee made its only previous World Series appearance as an American League team in 1982, falling in seven games to the St. Louis Cardinals. Milwaukee won two of the three games against visiting Tampa Bay during the regular season in a series played March 30-April 1. --Field Level Media

item.title: Meta afirma ante justicia electoral brasileña que trata por igual a las campañas de Lula y Bolsonaro
item.description: Meta Platforms , propietaria de Facebook, Instagram y WhatsApp, comunicó el martes a la justicia electoral de Brasil que ha adoptado medidas para garantizar la igualdad de trato en sus plataformas entre las campañas del presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva y del senador Flávio Bolsonaro.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Meta Platforms (META.O) , propietaria de Facebook, Instagram y WhatsApp, comunicó el martes a la justicia electoral de Brasil que ha adoptado medidas para garantizar la igualdad de trato en sus plataformas entre las campañas del presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva y del senador Flávio Bolsonaro. La comunicación se produjo después de que un magistrado del Tribunal Superior Electoral concediera a la empresa 24 horas para demostrar que había aplicado medidas que garantizaran una distribución equitativa de los contenidos de cara a la segunda vuelta de las elecciones, que tendrán lugar el domingo. La campaña de Lula había presentado inicialmente una denuncia ante el órgano máximo de la justicia electoral cuestionando las acciones de Meta y alegando que [USN:L6N4620XB TEXT:"favorecía la candidatura de Bolsonaro"], algo que la empresa niega. En un escrito de nueve páginas al que ha tenido acceso Reuters, Meta enumeró las 17 iniciativas que ha adoptado para cumplir con la orden judicial. Meta adjuntó una declaración técnica en la que confirma que el contenido relacionado con ambas campañas se trata de forma equitativa y no discriminatoria, y en la que describe los mecanismos que garantizan dicha igualdad. Meta afirmó que había implantado una revisión previa por parte de personal humano de las cuentas publicitarias de ambas campañas. Cualquier restricción automática impuesta a las cuentas publicitarias de ambas campañas se revisa en un plazo de dos horas, un proceso que se mantendrá vigente hasta la segunda vuelta del domingo, agregó.

item.title: Príncipe Enrique afirma que quiere reconciliarse con su familia
item.description: El príncipe Enrique dijo que espera reconciliarse con el rey Carlos y el resto de su familia, con quienes se distanció cuando se mudó a Estados Unidos hace seis años.
item.dc:creator: Michael Holden
item.content:encoded: El príncipe Enrique dijo que espera reconciliarse con el rey Carlos y el resto de su familia, con quienes se distanció cuando se mudó a Estados Unidos hace seis años. Enrique, el hijo menor del rey de 42 años, provocó una gran ruptura en la familia real británica cuando él y su esposa, Meghan, renunciaron a sus obligaciones protocolares y se mudaron a California en 2020, desde donde se mostraron muy críticos con la institución. Apenas ha hablado con su hermano mayor, el príncipe Guillermo, heredero al trono, desde hace años, y su familia solo se ha reunido de nuevo con su padre recientemente. En una entrevista con la revista GQ, Enrique, que recientemente se ha trasladado de nuevo a Gran Bretaña con Meghan y sus dos hijos, ha dicho que quería limar asperezas. "Con todo lo que está pasando en el mundo, lo más importante es reconciliarse", declaró a GQ, señalando que entiende el interés que suscita la situación de su familia, ya que la gente se identifica con ella. "Hay gente que no quiere que salga bien. Yo quiero que salga bien", añadió. El portavoz de Enrique señaló que estos últimos comentarios no pretendían ser un ataque a Guillermo ni a ningún otro miembro de la familia. El duque de Sussex dijo a GQ que, aunque "las cicatrices permanecen para siempre", quería animar a todo el mundo a dejar atrás el pasado. "Para mí, ya hay suficiente drama en el mundo y suficiente drama en la vida de las personas como para seguir con los problemas familiares", afirmó. "No merece la pena".

item.title: Activist Jana takes stake in Casella Waste, urges changes
item.description: Activist investment firm Jana Partners has built a new position in Casella Waste Systems and wants the regional waste services company to improve its profit margins and returns on invested capital, the firm's managing partner and portfolio manager said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Svea Herbst-Bayliss
item.content:encoded: Activist investment firm Jana Partners has built a new position in Casella Waste Systems (CWST.O) and wants the regional waste services company to improve its profit margins and returns on invested capital, the firm's managing partner and portfolio manager said on Tuesday. The Rutland, Vermont-headquartered company, which has a market value of roughly $5.6 billion, has had its shares fall around 11% this year and has traded roughly flat over the past five years while competitors have performed better. "Improving margins and operational execution can drive returns on capital, reignite its attractive growth flywheel and unlock Casella’s discounted valuation," Jana managing partner and portfolio manager Scott Ostfeld said at the 13D Monitor Active-Passive Investor Summit in New York. At the same time, its depressed valuation and strong position in the northeastern United States could make Casella an attractive target for buyers, Ostfeld said. Casella is one of the last remaining regional solid waste companies in the public market. Buying up waste businesses has been a popular investment theme for private equity and infrastructure funds including Blackstone, EQT, Ares and TPG, and for larger industry buyers including Waste Management (WM.N) and GFL Environmental. Casella did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The company, which was founded five decades ago with a single garbage truck, has struggled to improve its margins and integrate its largest-ever acquisition. In 2023, it bought mid-Atlantic waste assets from GFL Environmental (GFL.TO) for $525 million. Now the hedge fund wants Casella to better align its compensation with shareholder value and to publicly commit to achieving 27% earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) margins by 2029, Ostfeld said. The company reported a margin of 22.7% for its quarter ended June 30, 2026. To improve performance and better keep pace with its public rivals, Ostfeld said Casella should hire a performance improvement consulting firm, something Jana also pushed for at French fry maker Lamb Weston (LW.N) . Lamb Weston has committed publicly to cutting hundreds of millions of dollars in costs. Jana is one of the industry's most prolific activist investors and recently [USN:L6N45K00O TEXT:"called on payments company Fiserv"] to work with software provider Palantir to speed up its own technology transformation program.

item.title: SpaceX investors, ahead of results, press Musk on Tesla merger
item.description: SpaceX shareholders want to know when the rocket maker will merge with Tesla , bringing together two of Elon Musk's biggest companies in a union that investors have long speculated about.
item.dc:creator: Akash Sriram
item.content:encoded: SpaceX (SPCX.O) shareholders want to know when the rocket maker will merge with Tesla (TSLA.O) , bringing together two of Elon Musk 's biggest companies in a union that investors have long speculated about. "When will SpaceX merge with Tesla?" was the second-most upvoted question — drawing 26 upvotes — submitted by investors to SpaceX management [USN:L6N46211S TEXT:"ahead of its third-quarter earnings "]webcast on Tuesday. The same question received 128 upvotes on the Tesla investor relations site. Barclays suggested last week that a deal could be announced before Tesla's annual meeting, with SpaceX the likelier acquirer, though neither company nor Musk has officially committed to favoring a deal. LUNAR LANDER PROGRESS QUESTIONED The top-voted question, with 38 upvotes, was on the progress of Starship's lunar lander hardware, in a list that showed retail investors were focused on Starship while analysts and institutional shareholders pressed for detail on AI revenue and spending. SpaceX has made progress testing Starship, but key technologies needed to turn the giant rocket into a lunar lander, including refueling it in orbit, have yet to be fully demonstrated. The company's profitable satellite internet service, Starlink, is helping bankroll heavy spending on chips, terrestrial data centers and Grok, but losses at the AI businesses have ballooned. While the investor questions list ahead of its second-quarter earnings in August was [USN:L6N43X13Z TEXT:"topped by lighthearted"], meme-driven submissions, this quarter's top questions leaned more toward corporate plans, with novelty entries mostly near the bottom. It was not clear which questions executives would take when the webcast starts at 4:30 p.m. EDT (2030 GMT). "What share of AI revenue is now under multi-year commitments, and what gives management confidence AI can grow at or above the company's overall rate for several years?" a prospective investor asked, earning no upvotes. SpaceX's AI revenue comes from a [USN:L4N42D1G4 TEXT:"handful of customers"], including Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) Google and [USN:L6N4250G5 TEXT:"AI lab Anthropic"], and the compute contracts can be terminated on about 90 days' notice. One institutional investor asked how much contracted Google capacity would stay available if a court halted gas turbines at the Colossus 2 data center in Memphis, Tennessee. Another asked whether Google had accepted the full capacity under its cloud agreement and whether SpaceX expected to earn the full contractual monthly rate. An analyst's six-part question on Starlink satellite capacity, launch priorities and capital spending drew no upvotes. Lighter submissions were scattered through the list. One user asked whether SpaceX would land a Tesla Roadster — a sports car with rocket thrusters for short jumps in the air — on the moon, adding, "(it) would be awesome."

item.title: Panthers G Jacob Markstrom injured in practice, out 10-14 days
item.description: Florida Panthers goaltender Jacob Markstrom is expected to miss 10-to-14 days with an injury sustained in practice, head coach Paul Maurice announced Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Florida Panthers goaltender Jacob Markstrom is expected to miss 10-to-14 days with an injury sustained in practice, head coach Paul Maurice announced Tuesday. The Panthers recalled Cooper Black from Charlotte of the American Hockey League on Tuesday to back up fellow goaltender Akira Schmid while Markstrom is sidelined. Markstrom, 36, has posted a 3-1-1 record with a 2.21 goals-against average and .897 save percentage in six games this season, including one shutout. He was acquired in a five-player trade with the New Jersey Devils on June 30. The Panthers picked up Markstrom and forward Angus Crookshank in that deal, while forwards Evan Rodrigues, Jesper Boqvist and prospect Ben Steeves went to the Devils. An All-Star in 2019-20 and a Vezina Trophy finalist in 2021-22, Markstrom is 267-232-65 with 26 shutouts, a 2.73 GAA and .906 save percentage in 584 games (566 starts) with the Panthers, Vancouver Canucks, Calgary Flames and Devils. Black, 25, is 2-1-0 with a 2.67 goals-against average and .919 save percentage in three appearances for the Checkers this season. He has yet to make his NHL debut. --Field Level Media

item.title: NBA finalizing Europe league club deals, Tatum says
item.description: The NBA is close to finalizing agreements with clubs for the initial phase of its own European league and plans to announce those teams soon, Deputy Commissioner Mark Tatum said on Tuesday while adding that the door to reaching an agreement with the Euroleague remains open.
item.dc:creator: Frank Pingue
item.content:encoded: The NBA is close to finalizing agreements with clubs for the initial phase of its own European league and plans to announce those teams soon, Deputy Commissioner Mark Tatum said on Tuesday while adding that the door to reaching an agreement with the Euroleague remains open. Tatum, speaking to reporters on the opening day of the [USN:L6N4620TK TEXT:"2026-27 NBA season"], said the league remains undeterred in powering ahead with NBA Europe next October even after [USN:L6N45S0R0 TEXT:"Europe’s biggest basketball clubs"] recently snubbed an offer to team up with the NBA. "Well, we're we're not stopping and we're moving and proceeding as quickly as we can," Tatum said on a video call. "Our plan is to begin rolling out this project in October of 2027, which is a year from now. So we've got a lot of work to do, but we're we're moving quickly and we're not slowing down at all." Tatum also said agreements with NBA Europe franchises are being finalized and that an announcement would be made in the "not-too-distant future". According to Tatum, the new league will result in the largest investment in European basketball, one that covers academies, grassroots development, league operations, marketing and arena infrastructure. DIFFERENT VISION FOR EUROPEAN BASKETBALL The NBA and world basketball governing body FIBA [USN:L2N3QA15L TEXT:"formally announced"] their plans in March for an NBA Europe venture, one that would be a mix of permanent franchises and others that would qualify on a yearly basis based on performance. The Euroleague currently consists of 13 permanent shareholder clubs but plans to approve up to eight long-term franchise licenses as it expands to a 24-club competition with new franchises expected to be announced in mid-November. "We have a different vision for European basketball than potentially the Euroleague had," Tatum told Reuters on Tuesday. "The Euroleague seemingly wants to double down on what they've been doing. We have a different vision. We have a vision of re-imagining and realigning the European basketball ecosystem that's built on a merit-based foundation that gives every fan the right to dream." According to Euroleague, approximately 40% of licensed clubs are considered financially sustainable. It projects that all licensed clubs will achieve financial sustainability by the end of the first phase of a [USN:L6N4620ST TEXT:"10-year business plan"] announced last week. 'MUCH MORE FINANCIAL STABILITY' Tatum questioned the Euroleague's expansion strategy and suggested the NBA's model would provide a quicker pathway to profitability. According to Tatum, permanent NBA Europe franchises are projected to be profitable by Year 3. "As I think about their plans for expansion, again, look at what they've said in terms of their teams and financial instability of the teams. And so ... when you add new teams, and teams already are not financially sustainable, is that a model that you want to follow?" Tatum said. His comments came a day after Euroleague CEO [USN:L6N4650V6 TEXT:"Chus"] Bueno warned of the dangers of further fragmenting the continent's basketball market, going as far as to call such a scenario "a disaster". According to Tatum, the choice is simple. "Our model will provide clubs with a much quicker path to profitability," said Tatum. "Over the first decade we project multibillions of dollars in distributions back to clubs. That is going to give them much more financial stability. It's going to give them the ability to reinvest in the basketball ecosystem."

item.title: É falso que pesquisa Quaest mostrou Lula com 54%; Flávio lidera com 46%
item.description: É falso que o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) tenha registrado 54% das intenções de voto para presidente, à frente do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), na pesquisa Quaest divulgada em 14 de outubro.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: É falso que o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) tenha registrado 54% das intenções de voto para presidente, à frente do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), na pesquisa Quaest divulgada em 14 de outubro. “Lula abre vantagem de 54% para 49% sobre Flávio, segundo a revista Quaest”, diz uma postagem no Instagram . Até esta terça-feira, a Quaest havia divulgado apenas uma pesquisa durante a campanha para o segundo turno. O relatório do levantamento, que está disponível no site da empresa, mostra Flávio e Lula em empate técnico. O candidato do PL aparece numericamente à frente, com 46%, contra 44% do petista. Segundo o levantamento, 9% dos entrevistados declararam voto branco, nulo ou disseram que não votarão, e 1% está indeciso. A margem de erro é de dois pontos percentuais para mais ou menos. A Quaest não divulgou percentuais de intenção de votos válidos, que são os considerados para determinar o resultado de uma eleição. Os votos válidos são aqueles dados nos candidatos, descontando-se brancos e nulos. Outro indicativo de que a postagem checada inventa números é que a soma dos percentuais atribuídos a Lula e Flávio na imagem dá 103%, em vez de 100%. VEREDICTO Falso. A pesquisa Quaest divulgada em 14 de outubro mostra Flávio Bolsonaro à frente de Lula com 46% a 44% das intenções de voto, respectivamente. item.title: Rubio animará a la empresa india Reliance a producir y refinar más petróleo venezolano
item.description: El secretario de Estado de Estados Unidos, Marco Rubio, tiene previsto animar a la empresa india Reliance Industries a refinar más crudo venezolano en sus refinerías locales y, posiblemente, a comenzar a producir petróleo en el país sudamericano, según dijo a periodistas el martes en Mumbai.
item.dc:creator: Gram Slattery
item.content:encoded: El secretario de Estado de Estados Unidos, Marco Rubio, tiene previsto animar a la empresa india Reliance Industries (RELI.NS) a refinar más crudo venezolano en sus refinerías locales y, posiblemente, a comenzar a producir petróleo en el país sudamericano, según dijo a periodistas el martes en Mumbai. Durante la visita de dos días a Mumbai y Jamnagar, en el oeste del país, Rubio tiene previsto reunirse con líderes gubernamentales y empresariales, entre ellos el ministro de Asuntos Exteriores, S. Jaishankar, y el multimillonario Mukesh Ambani, presidente de Reliance Industries, que gestiona el mayor complejo de refinación del mundo. "Mañana hablaremos con Reliance sobre (refinar más crudo venezolano) (...) Ya lo han hecho en el pasado, y creo que, a medida que se vaya incorporando cada vez más petróleo venezolano al mercado, es algo que pueden hacer", dijo Rubio a periodistas. Las dos enormes refinerías de Reliance en el complejo de Jamnagar, con una capacidad conjunta de unos 1,4 millones de barriles diarios de crudo, son capaces de procesar los ultrapesados de Venezuela, algunos de los cuales tienen una consistencia similar a la del lodo. A medida que la producción petrolera de Venezuela ha aumentado, después de que Estados Unidos capturó al exlíder venezolano Nicolás Maduro en enero, Reliance se ha convertido en un importante importador del crudo del país. Cuando se le preguntó si discutiría con Venezuela la posibilidad de que la propia Reliance produzca petróleo, Rubio respondió que el asunto ya se había debatido en el pasado y que volvería a plantearse. Aunque Reliance es una importante refinadora de crudo venezolano, no opera dentro del país sudamericano. "Vamos a ver cuál es el escollo y qué oportunidades existen (...) Se trata de una empresa que ha tenido presencia en Venezuela en el pasado y cuya capacidad de refino es considerable", agrego.

item.title: EdenTree fund manager Hiorns has bought up French stocks despite civil unrest
item.description: Chris Hiorns, who manages around £1 billion ($1.3 billion) for investment company EdenTree, has recently bought up several French stocks for the EdenTree Sustainable European Equity Fund despite the recent civil unrest in France.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chris Hiorns, who manages around £1 billion ($1.3 billion) for investment company EdenTree, has recently bought up several French stocks for the EdenTree Sustainable European Equity Fund despite the recent civil [USN:L6N4660DJ TEXT:"unrest"] in France. • In a note published on Tuesday, Hiorns said he had added more shares in property company Gecina (GFCP.PA) to the fund. • Hiorns has also increased the fund's position in property company Covivio (CVO.PA) , utility company Veolia (VIE.PA) and supermarket retailer Carrefour (CARR.PA) • The EdenTree Sustainable European Equity Fund, which manages around £365 million, also holds stakes in healthcare company Sanofi (SASY.PA) and tyre maker Michelin (MICP.PA) • "Despite the somewhat bleak political and macroeconomic outlook, we still believe there are attractive opportunities to be found on the French stock market, with companies often far more resilient to economic, financial and political turmoil than their valuations would suggest," said Hiorns • Hiorns said many such French stocks could be trading with a "French political discount in place", given the backdrop of the violent demonstrations and uncertainty ahead of next year's presidential elections • Opinion polls put far-right leader Marine Le Pen as the likely winner • "The possibility of a far-right candidate coming to power at France's next presidential election adds another layer of uncertainty for investors. However, political outcomes are notoriously difficult to price, which is why we continue to focus on company fundamentals rather than making broad macroeconomic bets," added Hiorns ($1 = 0.7479 pounds)

item.title: Instacart settles US probe over foreign worker recruiting for $5 million
item.description: Instacart parent Maplebear will pay $5 million to settle a federal investigation into claims that the grocery delivery company discriminated against American workers through its recruiting and hiring practices, two US agencies said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Wiessner
item.content:encoded: Instacart parent Maplebear (CART.O) will pay $5 million to settle a federal investigation into claims that the grocery delivery company discriminated against American workers through its recruiting and hiring practices, two US agencies said on Tuesday. The US Department of Justice and Equal Employment Opportunity Commission said they had uncovered evidence that Instacart preferred to hire foreign workers through an employment-based green card program rather than Americans for unspecified jobs. Maplebear will pay $1 million in penalties and up to $4 million to affected people who applied for jobs between December 2023 and February 2026, the agencies said. The company also agreed to post job openings available to foreign workers on its public website and accept electronic applications from Americans. Instacart, in a statement provided by a spokesperson, said the company encourages qualified US job seekers to apply for jobs and seeks to attract broad pools of candidates for open positions. "While we maintain that our practices complied with all applicable laws and regulations, we’re pleased to have resolved this matter so we can keep our full focus on delivering on our mission for customers, shoppers, retailers, and brands," the company said. President Donald Trump , a Republican, has [USN:S0N43501J TEXT:"sought to crack down"] on what he says are widespread abuses of foreign worker visa programs. The Justice Department has since last year compiled more than a dozen settlements with companies accused of discriminating against Americans, including [USN:L1N4410V6 TEXT:"a $3.2 million deal"] with OpenAI announced in August. OpenAI denied claims that it discouraged Americans from applying for jobs. The EEOC, which enforces federal laws banning workplace discrimination, has separately announced a handful of settlements and lawsuits against companies accused of bias against American workers.

item.title: Polícia britânica prende dupla suspeita de ajudar inteligência iraniana em incidente na base RAF Fairford
item.description: A polícia britânica informou nesta terça-feira que voltou a prender dois homens sob suspeita de colaborar com os serviços de inteligência iranianos, como parte de sua investigação sobre as atividades ocorridas na base aérea RAF Fairford no mês passado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A polícia britânica informou nesta terça-feira que voltou a prender dois homens sob suspeita de colaborar com os serviços de inteligência iranianos, como parte de sua investigação sobre as atividades ocorridas na base aérea RAF Fairford no mês passado. A RAF Fairford havia sido utilizada por bombardeiros norte-americanos para realizar ataques contra o Irã, mas os bombardeiros B-1 norte-americanos foram retirados logo após a prisão de cinco britânicos nas proximidades da base militar, no sudoeste da Inglaterra, na madrugada de 27 de setembro. Outros dois homens foram presos posteriormente pela polícia, embora todos os sete tenham sido liberados sob fiança. A Unidade de Combate ao Terrorismo (CTP, na sigla em inglês) informou nesta terça-feira, no entanto, que dois indivíduos haviam sido presos novamente com base na Lei de Segurança Nacional. A CTP informou em um comunicado que havia prendido novamente um cidadão britânico de 24 anos, que havia sido inicialmente detido nas proximidades da RAF Fairford, e também um cidadão com dupla nacionalidade britânica e iraniana, de 25 anos, que já havia sido preso anteriormente em Londres. O comissário-adjunto Laurence Taylor, chefe da Polícia Nacional Antiterrorismo do Reino Unido, afirmou em comunicado: “Esta é uma investigação em andamento, e nossa coleta de provas continua, mas, neste momento, nossa posição permanece a mesma; consideramos altamente provável que haja envolvimento do Estado iraniano.” O primeiro-ministro britânico, Andy Burnham, afirmou na semana passada que as atividades na base RAF Fairford provavelmente foram coordenadas no Irã, o que foi negado pelo embaixador do Irã no Reino Unido. “Sabemos que o público tem perguntas sem resposta”, disse Taylor, da CTP. “Quero ser o mais transparente possível e, quando estivermos em condições de compartilhar mais informações, o faremos.”

item.title: Zelenskiy diz que EUA restabeleceram alertas para Ucrânia sobre ataques balísticos russos
item.description: O presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, afirmou nesta terça-feira que a Ucrânia está grata aos EUA pelo restabelecimento das informações de inteligência e dos alertas antecipados sobre ataques balísticos russos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, afirmou nesta terça-feira que a Ucrânia está grata aos EUA pelo restabelecimento das informações de inteligência e dos alertas antecipados sobre ataques balísticos russos. Em coletiva de imprensa em Oslo, após se reunir com negociadores de paz dos EUA, Zelenskiy disse que a Ucrânia não estava perdendo a guerra contra a Rússia, mas que Kiev estava perdendo seu povo e segue empenhada em encontrar caminhos para a paz. Ele reiterou que a Ucrânia espera discutir questões-chave sobre como pôr fim à guerra durante uma reunião trilateral entre os líderes.

item.title: Polish lawmakers vote to ease abortion ban, but face likely presidential veto
item.description: Poland's lower house of parliament on Tuesday voted to allow abortion in case of foetal abnormalities and to decriminalise providing help in getting an abortion, as lawmakers seek to reverse a near-total abortion ban introduced by the previous government.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Poland's lower house of parliament on Tuesday voted to allow abortion in case of foetal abnormalities and to decriminalise providing help in getting an abortion, as lawmakers seek to reverse a near-total abortion ban introduced by the previous government. The legislation, however, is almost certain to be vetoed by the nationalist president. Poland, a predominantly Catholic country, introduced a near-total [USN:KBN29W1ZM TEXT:"abortion ban"] in 2021 after the constitutional court ruled that terminations due to foetal abnormalities were unconstitutional. The abortion ban led to widespread protests. Prime Minister Donald Tusk's pro-European coalition won the 2023 election partly on a pledge to ease abortion restrictions. President Karol Nawrocki has signalled he would block any liberalisation of the law. "The reality is that these pieces of legislation represent very limited small-scale reform and would not improve the situation for most women in Poland who need abortion care," Leah Hoctor, Vice President for Europe at the Center for Reproductive Rights, told Reuters. Separate draft legislation that would legalise abortion on request up to 12 weeks of pregnancy is under consideration in parliamentary committees. Tusk's government had earlier taken steps to expand access to abortions under existing regulations which allow abortion on mental health grounds. Under the current law, abortion is only legal in cases involving rape or incest, or when a woman's health or life is at risk.

item.title: Trump, Bloomberg ramp up spending ahead of midterms
item.description: US President Donald Trump said on Tuesday that he would spend more than $400 million on Republican campaign efforts, while the New York Times reported that former New York City mayor Michael Bloomberg was spending $80 million to help Democrats ahead of the November 3 midterm congressional elections.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump said on Tuesday that he would spend more than $400 million on Republican campaign efforts, while the New York Times reported that former New York City mayor Michael Bloomberg was spending $80 million to help Democrats ahead of the November 3 midterm congressional elections . The financial commitments come as Democrats seek to win control of Congress from Trump's Republicans in the November 3 midterm elections. "I have spent, or will be spending, over 400 Million Dollars by Election Day. More than 300 Million Dollars has already been spent on Advertising, Direct and Indirect Voter Contact, Rallies, Rally Arenas, Telerallies, Get Out the Vote Programs, Election Integrity, and more," Trump said in a social media post. Trump's super PAC, MAGA Inc., and an affiliated group, No Going Back PAC, have spent at least $226 million on the elections so far, campaign filings show. Bloomberg's team told the New York Times that he was sending about $80 million to Democrats in September and October. Bloomberg's office did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The New York Times said at least $50 million of Bloomberg’s money was being used for House races, including $24 million for Everytown for Gun Safety, a group Bloomberg co-founded. He was also giving $16 million to House Majority PAC, the main super PAC aligned with House Democratic leadership. Reuters has not independently verified the spending by Bloomberg.

item.title: GRANOS La soja y el maíz caen a mínimos de varias semanas por ventas de fondos y cosechas
item.description: Los futuros de la soja estadounidense caían el martes a un mínimo de dos meses, mientras que los del maíz bajaban a uno de dos meses y medio, debido a fondos que liquidaron posiciones y a la presión derivada de una cosecha que se prevé récord en Estados Unidos.
item.dc:creator: Karl Plume
item.content:encoded: Los futuros de la soja estadounidense caían el martes a un mínimo de dos meses, mientras que los del maíz bajaban a uno de dos meses y medio, debido a fondos que liquidaron posiciones y a la presión derivada de una cosecha que se prevé récord en Estados Unidos. Los futuros del trigo siguieron la tendencia bajista del maíz y la soja, hundiéndose a su nivel más bajo desde mediados de julio debido a las ventas de los fondos y al desplome de la demanda. Las previsiones de que el tiempo seguirá siendo favorable para la cosecha en el Medio Oeste, al menos hasta finales de esta semana, lastraron los mercados de productos agrícolas, mientras los agricultores recogían una cosecha récord de soja y la que se prevé que sea la segunda de la historia de maíz. La presión de la cosecha eclipsó la renovada demanda china de soja estadounidense. El Departamento de Agricultura de Estados Unidos (USDA) confirmó nuevas compras del principal importador mundial. "Los chinos han estado comprando, pero el problema es que están comprando los 25 millones (de toneladas métricas) que ya sabíamos que iban a comprar. Parece que ahora ya está todo decidido", dijo Jim McCormick, director de operaciones de AgMarket. "En este momento, lo que hay es simplemente la presión tradicional de las operaciones de cobertura, amplificada por cierta liquidación de fondos". El contrato de soja para noviembre de la Bolsa de Comercio de Chicago bajaba 7,25 centavos, a 12,4625 dólares el bushel, a las 1657 GMT, un mínimo desde el 26 de agosto. El maíz para diciembre caía 5,75 centavos, a 4,6125 dólares el bushel, su precio más bajo desde el 12 de agosto. La cosecha de ambos cultivos se encontraba ligeramente bajo el ritmo promedio, pero los meteorólogos prevén condiciones secas al menos durante el resto de esta semana, lo que impulsará el avance de los trabajos en el campo. El USDA indicó que al domingo se había cosechado el 44% del maíz de Estados Unidos, menos que la media de los últimos cinco años, que es del 52% en esta fase de la temporada. La cosecha de soja se encontraba completa en un 64%, un punto porcentual menos que el promedio. El contrato de trigo para diciembre bajaba 12 centavos, a 6,4325 dólares el bushel, su nivel más bajo desde el 10 de julio.

item.title: França vai mobilizar militares contra protestos e admite falhas em distúrbios do fim de semana
item.description: A França reforçará o efetivo policial com militares e realizará uma grande operação de segurança para os novos protestos previstos para sábado, informou o governo nesta terça-feira, reconhecendo falhas em sua resposta à violência do último fim de semana.
item.dc:creator: Elizabeth Pineau, Dominique Vidalon
item.content:encoded: A França reforçará o efetivo policial com militares e realizará uma grande operação de segurança para os novos protestos previstos para sábado, informou o governo nesta terça-feira, reconhecendo falhas em sua resposta à violência do último fim de semana. “A mobilização no próximo sábado será maciça”, disse o primeiro-ministro Sébastien Lecornu, acrescentando que a prioridade imediata é restaurar a ordem após os distúrbios e saques que varreram Paris, Marselha, Lyon e outras cidades em 17 de outubro. Em um debate por vezes acalorado, o ministro do Interior, Laurent Nuñez, disse que os militares seriam mobilizados ao lado da polícia, enquanto o governo se comprometeu a reformular suas táticas após críticas generalizadas de que os centros das cidades haviam ficado vulneráveis. Enquadrando a crise como uma escolha “entre a violência e a República”, Lecornu atribuiu a responsabilidade pelos distúrbios a grupos de extrema-esquerda, que, por sua vez, acusaram o governo de subestimar a indignação da população em relação ao alto custo de vida e ao declínio dos serviços públicos. A agitação chocou a França tanto por sua magnitude quanto pela aparente incapacidade da polícia de contê-la, inflamando as tensões às vésperas das eleições presidenciais do próximo ano, com candidatos da extrema-direita e da extrema-esquerda apresentando bom desempenho nas pesquisas. Protestos em outros países europeus, incluindo Itália e Albânia, aumentaram as preocupações de que a indignação com os padrões de vida corra o risco de se espalhar pelo continente, em um momento em que muitas nações, incluindo a França, enfrentam dificuldades orçamentárias. Uma noite de relativa calma na França se seguiu aos toques de recolher seletivos impostos em várias áreas afetadas pelo caos, o que, segundo o governo, ajudou a restabelecer o controle. Os toques de recolher localizados, alguns direcionados a crianças e adolescentes menores de 18 anos, foram prorrogados até a noite de terça-feira, informou a polícia. Lecornu reconheceu falhas na resposta do Estado no fim de semana, afirmando que houve falhas de inteligência, enquanto o posicionamento da polícia foi muito estático e as autoridades cometeram o erro de não cancelar as folgas programadas para os policiais. Nuñez pediu desculpas pelos erros. “Lamento profundamente o que aconteceu. Aceito minha parcela de responsabilidade”, disse ele. A rede de supermercados Carrefour informou ter sofrido perdas de dezenas de milhões de euros devido a furtos e danos, alertando que enfrentava uma “situação sem precedentes” por causa dos distúrbios. A principal união estudantil da França, a Unef, convocou novos protestos para sábado, comprometendo-se a manter a pressão sobre o governo de Macron em relação ao que considera um sistema educacional em deterioração e com financiamento insuficiente. “Vamos continuar”, afirmou a união nas redes sociais. Por outro lado, grupos que se identificam como “Gilets Jaunes” (Coletes Amarelos) convocaram ações de protesto contra o aumento dos preços dos combustíveis. O movimento dos coletes amarelos, praticamente inativo nos últimos anos, surgiu em 2018, durante o primeiro mandato de Macron, em resposta aos planos de aumento dos impostos sobre a gasolina. Os bloqueios de trânsito se estenderam por meses até que o governo fizesse concessões onerosas que agora não tem condições de arcar.

item.title: Meta tells Brazil court it treats Lula and Bolsonaro campaigns equally
item.description: Meta Platforms , owner of Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp, told Brazil's Superior Electoral Court on Tuesday that it has adopted measures to ensure equal treatment of President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's and Senator Flavio Bolsonaro's presidential campaigns on its platforms.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Meta Platforms (META.O) , owner of Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp, told Brazil's Superior Electoral Court on Tuesday that it has adopted measures to ensure equal treatment of President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's and Senator Flavio Bolsonaro's presidential campaigns on its platforms. The filing came after an Electoral Court justice gave the company 24 hours to prove it had implemented measures ensuring equal content distribution ahead of Sunday's election runoff. Lula's campaign had initially complained to the court, questioning Meta's actions and alleging the company [USN:L6N4620XB TEXT:"favored Bolsonaro's candidacy"], which Meta denies. In a nine-page filing seen by Reuters, Meta listed 17 initiatives it took to comply with the court order. Meta attached a technical declaration confirming content related to both campaigns is treated equally and non-discriminatorily, describing mechanisms ensuring equality. Meta said it implemented prior human review of ad accounts for both campaigns. Any automated restrictions on the two campaigns' ad accounts are reviewed within two hours, a process that will remain in place until the runoff on Sunday.

item.title: Nigeria confirms Ebola case in patient who arrived from Uganda
item.description: Nigeria's government said on Tuesday there was a case of Ebola in the capital, Abuja, after laboratory tests confirmed the viral infection.
item.dc:creator: Elisha Bala-Gbogbo, Camillus Eboh
item.content:encoded: Nigeria's government said on Tuesday there was a case of Ebola in the capital, Abuja, after laboratory tests confirmed the viral infection. Health Minister Muhammad Ali Pate told the public broadcaster that the female patient had travelled from Uganda in East Africa. "She is in isolation, and she is receiving quality medical care. Contact tracing has been conducted, and it's under way as we speak, with 44 contacts already identified," Pate told public broadcaster NTA. Asked for comment, Ugandan government spokesperson Alan Kasujja said: "There's no Ebola in Uganda." Pate said in a statement that the patient had been admitted to a private hospital in Abuja, where she had received care for several days before the diagnosis was confirmed. "Nigeria successfully contained Ebola in 2014, and we have the experience and public health systems to respond to this case," the minister said in the statement. An Ebola outbreak was declared in Democratic Republic of Congo in mid-May and has since grown into the world's [USN:L8N45Z1AX TEXT:"second-largest"] outbreak ever, caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain. Uganda reported 20 cases in May and June, mostly imported from Congo, but was [USN:L6N44N0VL TEXT:"declared free"] of the virus by the World Health Organization in August. Kenya has reported [USN:L1N4660OP TEXT:"nine Ebola cases"] this month, all linked to a person who had travelled from Congo. Africa's top public health agency has started mobilising support for Nigeria, said its head, Jean Kaseya. "This Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has already become the most geographically extensive in history, affecting ... countries spread across three regions of Africa," Kaseya said in a post on X.

item.title: Carrefour advierte de que los disturbios y los saqueos en Francia afectarán a sus ganancias
item.description: Carrefour recortó el martes sus previsiones de ganancias anuales, achacándolo a una "situación sin precedentes" en Francia, ya que los disturbios, los saqueos y los toques de queda aumentaron los costos y perturbaron la actividad comercial en sus tiendas.
item.dc:creator: Helen Reid, Dominique Vidalon
item.content:encoded: Carrefour recortó el martes sus previsiones de ganancias anuales, achacándolo a una "situación sin precedentes" en Francia, ya que los disturbios, los saqueos y los toques de queda aumentaron los costos y perturbaron la actividad comercial en sus tiendas. La cadena de supermercados afirmó que ahora espera un crecimiento "estable o ligeramente positivo" en el beneficio por acción ajustado de 2026, tras haber pronosticado anteriormente un crecimiento de un porcentaje de un solo dígito alto. También prevé un ligero descenso del flujo de caja libre en comparación con 2025. Carrefour (CARR.PA) señaló que los disturbios estaban minando la confianza de los consumidores, que ya se encontraba debilitada debido a los elevados precios del combustible, y que estaban reduciendo la afluencia de clientes a sus tiendas justo cuando comienza el importante periodo comercial del cuarto trimestre. "Los costos directos ascienden a varias decenas de millones de euros... en mercancía robada o destruida, tiendas dañadas, equipamiento dañado, y además están las tiendas que nos hemos visto obligados a cerrar", declaró a los periodistas el director financiero de Carrefour, Matthieu Malige. "En las próximas semanas seguiremos viéndonos afectados, ya que algunas tiendas tienen que cerrar antes debido a los toques de queda y, en términos más generales, creemos que nos encontramos en una nueva situación marcada por una profunda incertidumbre para nuestros clientes". Malige señaló que 50 tiendas de Carrefour se vieron directamente afectadas por los disturbios y que muchas más cerraron como medida preventiva, incluso el domingo y el lunes. Se negó a facilitar el número total de tiendas cerradas. Los costos han aumentado debido a las medidas adoptadas por las tiendas para protegerse, incluida la contratación de guardias de seguridad externos, señaló Malige. Como consecuencia, Carrefour anunció que reduciría su inversión en Francia, recortando su previsión de gasto de capital para el año de 1.700 millones de euros a 1.600 millones de euros (1.800 millones de dólares). La cadena minorista se estaba preparando para iniciar sus campañas de rebajas del "Viernes Negro" en los próximos días, añadió Malige. (1 dólar = 0,8904 euros)

item.title: Sinergia de até R$2,2 bi em união Yduqs/Afya "é piso", diz executivo
item.description: A sinergia a ser gerada pela união dos grupos de ensino superior Afya e Ydqus poderá ser bem maior que a previsão de R$2 bilhões a R$2,2 bilhões anunciada no mês passado, quando as duas empresas comunicaram a combinação de negócios, disse o presidente-executivo da Afya, Virgílio Gibbon, nesta terça-feira.
item.dc:creator: Rodrigo Viga Gaier
item.content:encoded: A sinergia a ser gerada pela união dos grupos de ensino superior Afya (AFYA.O) e Ydqus (YDUQ3.SA) poderá ser bem maior que a previsão de R$2 bilhões a R$2,2 bilhões anunciada no mês passado, quando as duas empresas comunicaram a combinação de negócios, disse o presidente-executivo da Afya, Virgílio Gibbon, nesta terça-feira. Segundo o executivo, o valor de até R$2,2 bilhões é apenas "um piso" e há um enorme potencial a ser explorado a partir da junção dos dois grupos de ensino. As ações da Afya exibiam alta de 2% em Nova York às 14h04 (horário de Brasília), enquanto os papeis da Yduqs mostravam avanço de 2,3% na B3. Gibbon, que participou de apresentação da Afya a investidores mais cedo, destacou que a projeção inclui apenas sinergias nas áreas de custos, despesas, novas tecnologias e investimento e não engloba outras oportunidades a serem exploradas. "(A sinergia) pode ser muito maior, R$2 bilhões é o piso", disse ele a jornalistas após a apresentação. "Só como exemplo, eles (Yduqs) têm 19 unidades puro sangue em medicina que não têm um curso de saúde como marca premium; imagina a gente colocar cinco, seis cursos de saúde com tíquete médio alto e crescer a operação de saúde", afirmou. Ao ser questionado, quanto maior poderia ser essa sinergia para além dos R$2,2 bilhões previamente projetados, o executivo declarou que ainda não é possível avaliar quanto as oportunidades exploráveis poderão render no total. A previsão de Gibbon é que 80% dos ganhos com sinergias sejam capturados nos três primeiros anos da fusão. A união das duas empresas anunciada em [USN:L1N45G0I0 TEXT:"setembro"] ainda precisa ser aprovada nas assembleias de acionistas que devem ocorrer entre fim de novembro e início de dezembro. O Cade também precisa aprovar o negócio. Gibbon se mostrou otimista com a aprovação da fusão pelo órgão de defesa da concorrência. Segundo ele, a chance da fusão não ser aprovada "é muito baixa, quase zero. Nossa sobreposição é de menos de 5% da nossa base de alunos. Agora, será a primeira vez que o Cade vai analisar ensino superior e graduação em medicina", disse o executivo. De acordo com ele, na área de medicina há três cidades onde há sobreposição de cursos de Afya e Yduqs, sendo elas Rio de Janeiro, Teresina e Ji-Paraná (RO).

item.title: Netflix morphs into same couch potato it smashed
item.description: A leadership shakeup and job cuts follow an estimated 25% drop in new monthly subscribers, to 1.2 mln, over the past year. Its botched Warner Bros deal also accentuated struggles that evoke ones the streamer inflicted on cable TV. Absent creative sparks, a similar fate awaits.
item.dc:creator: Jennifer Saba
item.content:encoded: Netflix (NFLX.O) is in danger of starring in a financial version of "Squid Game." Slowdowns in subscriber and revenue growth, along with its botched $83 billion deal to buy Warner Bros., threaten to leave the pioneering streaming service fighting for its life like the contestants in its most popular show ever. The company's top line for the three months ending in September is projected to rise nearly 12% from a year earlier, according to estimates gathered by LSEG. It would be the slowest rate in 11 quarters. Co-Chief Executive Ted Sarandos bluntly said last month that he was not happy with the trajectory. Netflix trimmed 6% of its [USN:L6N4600X7 TEXT:"workforce,"] or about 1,000 people, and is shaking up leadership. Peter Rice, a former Walt Disney and Fox executive, will be overseeing both content and film, replacing two ousted executives who previously held the roles. There has not been enough hit programming, like its adaptation of John Steinbeck's “East of Eden” featuring Florence Pugh. As a result, Netflix clocked 1.2 million new subscribers in September, 25% fewer than during the same month in 2025, according to data cruncher Antenna. Such deceleration probably helps explain the desire to acquire rival HBO and the Warner Bros studio, which ultimately were sold to Paramount instead. The splashy acquisition proposal nevertheless rattled shareholders accustomed to a company that builds rather than buys, and put a brighter spotlight on Netflix's struggles. Under founder Reed Hastings, Netflix upended the cushy world of cable and satellite TV, and their monthly bundles, by going to consumers directly with an independent offering available over the internet. The new model forced incumbents to consolidate as their technology-focused competitor spent heavily and commanded a valuation of some 300 times earnings. It now trades at about 19 times the projected bottom line over the next 12 months. The multiple is a healthy premium to Comcast's six times, and even Walt Disney's 15 times. Even so, Netflix now finds itself seeking ways to avoid becoming one of the same couch potatoes it smashed, as YouTube, TikTok and other apps attract younger and bigger audiences. Finding and producing programming that appeals to wide audiences is always hit or miss in Hollywood, and new ideas and formats inevitably come around. As the dystopian "Squid Game" made all too clear, capitalism is merciless. Follow Jennifer Saba on Bluesky and LinkedIn . Netflix is due to report its quarterly financial results on October 20, with revenue expected to grow 12% from a year earlier, according to estimates compiled by LSEG. The streaming service cut 6% of its workforce, or 1,000 employees, its biggest reduction since 2022, Reuters reported on October 14, citing an internal memo. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: Irã diz a chefe do Exército do Paquistão que não haverá negociações com EUA até que exigências sejam atendidas
item.description: O Irã informou ao comandante do Exército do Paquistão, nesta terça-feira, que não haverá negociações com Washington até que as exigências de Teerã sejam atendidas, segundo a mídia iraniana, ressaltando o endurecimento de sua postura, apesar dos esforços de mediação do Paquistão, seu principal interlocutor.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Irã informou ao comandante do Exército do Paquistão, nesta terça-feira, que não haverá negociações com Washington até que as exigências de Teerã sejam atendidas, segundo a mídia iraniana, ressaltando o endurecimento de sua postura, apesar dos esforços de mediação do Paquistão, seu principal interlocutor. O presidente Masoud Pezeshkian discutiu os esforços de mediação e os desdobramentos regionais com o marechal de campo Asim Munir em Teerã, segundo a Nournews. O Paquistão é um mediador fundamental entre os EUA e o Irã. Seus esforços anteriores de mediação com ambas as partes resultaram em um acordo de paz provisório assinado em junho. Mas o Memorando de Islamabad rapidamente fracassou, em meio a novos confrontos entre o Irã e os EUA semanas depois. Munir também se reuniu com o presidente do Parlamento iraniano, Mohammed Baqer Qalibaf. O representante iraniano afirmou que Washington não poderá conquistar a confiança de Teerã até que cumpra as sete condições apresentadas pelo Irã para a reabertura do Estreito de Ormuz no mês passado, de acordo com um comunicado iraniano sobre a reunião. As condições do Irã incluem, entre outras exigências, o fim do bloqueio dos EUA aos seus portos, o fim das sanções dos EUA às suas exportações de petróleo, bem como o fim das hostilidades em todas as frentes regionais. O chefe de segurança do Irã, Mohsen Rezaei, transmitiu uma mensagem semelhante durante uma reunião separada com Munir, afirmando que não haverá negociações com Washington até que as exigências de Teerã sejam atendidas, segundo a mídia iraniana. Rezaei também afirmou que todos os materiais nucleares enriquecidos permaneceriam no Irã, reiterando a posição do líder supremo, o aiatolá Mojtaba Khamenei, de que o urânio quase apto para uso militar não deveria ser enviado para o exterior. O vice-presidente dos EUA, JD Vance, afirmou neste mês que o Irã deve fazer uma redução “significativa” em sua capacidade de enriquecimento de urânio para satisfazer as exigências dos EUA e pôr fim à guerra entre os dois países, que já dura oito meses. Israel, os Estados Unidos e outros países ocidentais há muito acusam o Irã de buscar armas nucleares, apontando, entre outras coisas, para sua iniciativa de enriquecer urânio a 60%, um nível muito superior ao necessário para usos civis e mais próximo dos 90% exigidos para a fabricação de armas. O Irã nega estar buscando armas nucleares.

item.title: Turkey bans 147 club officials for 45 days in betting probe
item.description: The Turkish Football Federation's disciplinary committee imposed 45-day bans on 147 current and former club officials on Tuesday for violating betting rules, as part of a sweeping investigation into gambling in Turkish soccer.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Turkish Football Federation's disciplinary committee imposed 45-day bans on 147 current and former club officials on Tuesday for violating betting rules, as part of a sweeping investigation into gambling in Turkish soccer. The Professional Football Disciplinary Board issued the penalties after reviewing the cases of 448 officials referred by the federation over allegations they had placed bets while serving at clubs. The committee found that 147 out of 448 individuals had violated betting rules and imposed 45-day penalties, which bar football officials from carrying out duties within the sport during the suspension period. Those sanctioned included Ertugrul Dogan, president of Super Lig club Trabzonspor, according to the committee's ruling. The board imposed no penalties in the other 301 cases after finding insufficient grounds for disciplinary action. The TFF said in September that it had [USN:L6N45N0SV TEXT:"provisionally suspended 448"] current and former club officials, who had served over the previous five years at clubs competing in Turkey's top two divisions. The federation said at the time that those referred had been found to have placed bets while holding club positions. The TFF has tightened its oversight of betting since a scandal rocked Turkish soccer [USN:L8N3W80RZ TEXT:"last year"]. The federation suspended [USN:L4N3WD01S TEXT:"149 referees"] and [USN:L1N3WM0RV TEXT:"1,024 players"] for various periods of time as part of the investigation.

item.title: Iran tells Pakistan army chief no talks with Washington until demands are met
item.description: Iran told Pakistan's army chief on Tuesday that there would be no talks with Washington until Tehran's demands were met, Iranian media reported, underscoring its hardening stance despite mediation efforts by key interlocutor Pakistan.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Iran told Pakistan's army chief on Tuesday that there would be no talks with Washington until Tehran's demands were met, Iranian media reported, underscoring its hardening stance despite mediation efforts by key interlocutor Pakistan. President Masoud Pezeshkian discussed mediation efforts and regional developments with Field Marshal Asim Munir in Tehran, according to Nournews. Pakistan is a key intermediary between the United States and Iran. Earlier mediation efforts helped produce an [USN:L1N42P0Q6 TEXT:"interim peace agreement"] in June, but the Islamabad Memorandum quickly unravelled as fighting between Iran and the US resumed weeks after. Munir also met Iranian parliament speaker Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, who said Washington could not regain Tehran's trust until it fulfilled [USN:S8N43Z003 TEXT:"seven conditions"] Iran set last month for reopening the Strait of Hormuz, according to an Iranian readout of the meeting. The demands include ending a US blockade on its ports, the lifting of sanctions on its oil exports as well as ending hostilities on all regional fronts. Iran's security chief, Mohsen Rezaei, delivered a similar message during a separate meeting with Munir, saying there would be [USN:L8N46515R TEXT:"no talks"] with Washington until Tehran's demands were met, according to Iranian media. Rezaei also said all enriched nuclear materials would remain in Iran, reiterating Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei's [USN:L8N41X1O4 TEXT:"position"] that near-weapons-grade uranium should not be shipped abroad. US Vice President JD Vance said [USN:L6N45S099 TEXT:"earlier this month"] that Iran must make a "meaningful" reduction in its uranium enrichment capacity to satisfy US demands and end the countries' eight-month-old war. Israel, the United States and other Western states have long accused Iran of seeking nuclear weapons, including pointing to its move to enrich uranium to 60%, far higher than needed for civilian uses and closer to the 90% needed for a weapon. Iran denies seeking nuclear weapons.

item.title: Food importer files new lawsuit to block Trump's Canada tariffs
item.description: US food importer Gellert Global Group on Tuesday sued to stop the Trump administration's latest tariffs on imports from Canada, saying that the duties represent another attempt to claim an unfettered presidential tariff power that has been roundly rejected in court.
item.dc:creator: Dietrich Knauth
item.content:encoded: US food importer Gellert Global Group on Tuesday sued to stop the Trump administration's latest tariffs on imports from Canada, saying that the duties represent another attempt to claim an unfettered presidential tariff power that has been roundly rejected in court. Republican President Donald Trump [USN:T5N43900P TEXT:"imposed 50% tariffs"] on a wide range of Canadian imports over the summer in response to what his administration called Canada's discriminatory treatment of US-made cars, alcohol and dairy goods. In imposing the tariffs, Trump invoked Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930, marking the law's first known usage in nearly a century of existence. The lawsuit, filed by the legal nonprofit Liberty Justice Center on behalf of the importer Gellert in the US Court of International Trade in New York, says that Trump has used shifting legal rationales and invoked rarely used US laws in a persistent effort to claim authority over tariff power that the US Constitution assigns to Congress. "No president should have the power to pull a dormant statute off the shelf and use it to impose sweeping tariffs or import bans without the limits Congress required,” said Sara Albrecht, chairman and CEO of the Liberty Justice Center. The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The lawsuit marks the fourth time a wide-ranging tariff policy has been challenged in court. The US Supreme Court in February [USN:L1N3YL0IM TEXT:"ruled against"] most of the tariffs Trump imposed in 2025, but the Trump administration has continued to issue wide-ranging tariffs that have been subject to legal challenges by US states and businesses. The US trade court has previously ruled against a [USN:L1N41K1T9 TEXT:"temporary 10% global tariff"] imposed by the Trump administration [USN:S0N3Z300D TEXT:"after"] its Supreme Court loss, and it is [USN:L1N45K0YB TEXT:"currently weighing"] the legality of a [USN:L6N43Q08M TEXT:"third round"] of global tariffs imposed in a purported effort to combat forced labor in international trade. The plaintiff in the current lawsuit, Gellert Global Group, is a New Jersey-based food importer with $1.7 billion in annual revenue. It imports Canadian cheeses that have been subjected to a 50% tariff, and it seeks to represent a class of businesses that are similarly impacted by the tariffs. The challenged tariffs were imposed under Section 338 of the 1930 Smoot-Hawley Tariff Act, and they target a wide range of Canadian imports including wine, furniture, dairy products, cement, clothing, fishing rods and hockey equipment. The new lawsuit argues that Section 338 has been overwritten by later tariff laws, including the Trade Act that Trump used to impose the forced labor tariffs earlier in 2026. Every statute that authorizes a US president to impose tariffs does so with strict limitations that the Trump administration has repeatedly ignored, the suit claims.

item.title: Phillips 66 locks out union workers at New Jersey refinery after contract expires
item.description: Phillips 66 has barred nearly 400 union workers from its Bayway refinery in Linden, New Jersey, after the collective bargaining agreement and an extension of the contract expired.
item.dc:creator: Nicole Jao
item.content:encoded: Phillips 66 (PSX.N) has barred nearly 400 union workers from its Bayway refinery in Linden, New Jersey, after the collective bargaining agreement and an extension of the contract expired. The labor dispute at Bayway, the largest refinery on the U.S. East Coast, comes as gasoline and diesel prices remain elevated amid disruptions to global energy supplies from conflicts in the Middle East and Russia. Any operational disruptions could further tighten fuel markets and drive prices higher. "In the absence of a further extension and to meet our commitment to safe and reliable operations, Phillips 66 has now locked out union-represented employees at those facilities," Phillips 66 said in a statement on Tuesday, adding that it plans to maintain safe operations at the Bayway oil refinery and Linden terminal with trained personnel to continue to meet market demands. The current collective bargaining agreement with union-represented employees at the Bayway refinery and Linden terminal expired on October 1. The contract extension expired on October 19.
